name: sonner
title: Toast (Sonner)
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Sonner Toaster: 3px panel with an offset second frame, stepped entrance, lettering titles, ink marks for success / info / warning / error, concentration lines while loading, a shake on error. ToastSfx adds an onomatopoeia in its own column. ToastCard renders a static toast with the same look for previews and docs. Toasts enter in three steps with motion lines under them.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/sonner". It wraps your own components/ui/sonner, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Toasts in a 3px panel, with room for a sound effect.
meta.usage:
import { Toaster, toast, ToastSfx } from "@/components/ui/manga/sonner"

<Toaster />

toast.success("Subscribed!")
toast("Level up!", { icon: <ToastSfx>DON!</ToastSfx> })

props.name: ToastCard
props.description: A static toast with the same look, for previews and docs. Takes type, title, description, icon and action.

props.name: ToastSfx
props.description: An onomatopoeia in its own column; pass it as the icon option of a toast.
